hook: Rivals on the pitch. Brothers after it.

items.label: Selfie King
items.line: Security runs in, and Ronaldo says, nah, let the kid get his picture. Main character, but make it wholesome.
items.clip_hint: Ronaldo stopping security so a young pitch invader can take a selfie (verificar el clip)

items.label: Tiny Hero
items.line: Neymar crying after the World Cup exit, and the one who comforts him is a rival player's little son. I'm not crying, you are.
items.clip_hint: Ivan Perišić's son hugging Neymar after Croatia vs Brazil, World Cup 2022

items.label: Real Friends
items.line: Mbappé just knocked his best friend out of the World Cup, and the first thing he does is go hug him.
items.clip_hint: Mbappé consoling Achraf Hakimi, France vs Morocco, World Cup 2022 semifinal

items.label: Shirt Swap Legends
items.line: Two icons, one swap, and the whole internet lost its mind. That's what respect looks like.
items.clip_hint: Shirt swap / hug between two current icons after a big match (verificar el clip)

items.label: The Hug
items.line: Messi finally wins with Argentina, and before celebrating, he goes straight to his crying best friend. That's the GOAT.
items.clip_hint: Messi hugging a crying Neymar after Argentina vs Brazil, Copa América final, Maracanã, July 2021
